draft.shortGloss: to touch; to play (music); to ring
draft.emotion: focused and deliberate, reaching out to make contact with something
notes: For physical contact, 'tocar' often takes the preposition 'em' ('tocar em algo'), though it can also be used directly ('tocar algo').
Do not confuse with 'pegar' (to grab, hold, or take): 'tocar' is just making contact.
